remarks: Welcome to your downtown retreat! The Chesterfield is a highly desirable, gated community offering two pools, 24-hour security, and beautifully manicured grounds, all within walking distance of everything downtown Stamford has to offer. This spacious and newly renovated 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse is filled with natural light and boasts an ideal layout. Step into the front foyer with new hardwood flooring throughout and enter a bright, modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops, vaulted ceilings, and contemporary finishes. The kitchen is fully equipped with brand-new appliances, including a dishwasher, microwave, stove, and refrigerator. A formal dining room, which could also serve as an office, leads into a large living room with a wood-burning fireplace and sliders to a private deck-perfect for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. Upstairs, a skylit loft offers a cozy sitting area, while the primary bedroom includes three closets, one of which is a walk-in with a new closet system. The spacious en-suite bath features double sinks. Conveniently located on the second floor is a laundry area with new front-loading washer and dryer. The unit includes parking for two cars, offering the perfect combination of city convenience and suburban comfort!
